top_stories.title: Watch: U.S. and Iran exchange strikes in major escalation | Above the Fold | 10.06.2026 - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Iran** is retaliating against **U.S.** military facilities, escalating tensions in West Asia. The **Congress** is facing a battle over **Meenakshi Natarajan’s** Rajya Sabha nomination. **Mamata Banerjee** met with **Sonia Gandhi**.

top_stories.title: Second Trinamool MP quits Rajya Sabha - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Sushmita Dev**, a Trinamool Congress MP, resigned from the Rajya Sabha and the party on Wednesday (June 10, 2026), citing her inability to fulfill the expectations of her constituents in Assam. **Dev** met with Assam Chief Minister **Himanta Biswa Sarma** shortly after her resignation, but did not confirm if it was a step towards joining the BJP.  This follows another MP's resignation from the party this week and speculation about ownership of the Trinamool Congress in the Lok Sabha.

top_stories.title: Sukhendu Sekhar Ray distances himself from TMC rebel group - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Sukhendu Sekhar Ray**, former TMC Chief Whip in the Rajya Sabha, resigned from his Upper House seat on Monday and praised colleagues who rebelled against **Mamata Banerjee** and her nephew, **Abhishek Banerjee**.  He clarified that he was unaware of a meeting with other rebels at actor-turned-politician **Shatabdi Roy's** residence before joining them for 30-40 minutes. Ray also stated his support for the rebellion but did not attend the meeting. He expressed hope for the new BJP government in West Bengal and acknowledged past harassment he faced within the TMC, prompting him to consider leaving politics altogether.

top_stories.title: What makes King Lynn’s Red Register so unique: A UNESCO-recognised book that preserves medieval England’s hidden history | World News - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organisation** (UNESCO) has recognized the Red Register, a worn volume of administrative records from 14th-century King's Lynn, England, as one of its earliest surviving paper-based archives. The register provides insights into daily life in the town during periods of crisis, such as the Black Death, and reveals how local governance operated in an era when record-keeping was still evolving. This recognition brings attention to a place often overlooked in historical narratives, highlighting the importance of small municipal records for understanding broader historical trends.

top_stories.title: Majority of workers with NCP(SP) official faction, claim leaders - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **P.M. Suresh Babu**, the new **NCP(SP)** State president, stated that a majority of party workers in Kerala remain loyal to the central leadership despite a split within the organization.  He refuted claims by a rival faction led by former Minister **A.K. Saseendran** and **Thomas K. Thomas**, stating that these allegations are baseless as **Supriya Sule**, the working president, attended the INDIA bloc meeting in New Delhi.  Babu asserted that the Kerala unit will stand firm with the Left front and reject attempts to induct the rival faction into the front.

top_stories.title: After viral video of elderly man beaten for objecting to spitting, Maharashtra Deputy CM seeks FIR | Mumbai News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: An elderly man was allegedly assaulted by a driver after he objected to the driver spitting on a road near Jupiter Hospital in Thane. **Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde** directed police to investigate an attempt-to-murder charge against the accused, who was later assaulted by local Shiv Sena and MNS workers. The incident sparked outrage and demands for action from leaders across party lines. Police are currently investigating the case.

top_stories.title: Indian-origin police officer Tarun Bali killed on duty in Canada's Ontario by mental hospital escapee - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Constable Tarun Bali**, an **Ontario Provincial Police** officer with two-and-a-half years of service, was killed in a line-of-duty incident near Hearst, Ontario on Tuesday. The 18-year-old suspect who allegedly struck Bali with a vehicle has been charged with first-degree murder.  The OPP is leading the investigation with assistance from other agencies. **Ontario Premier Doug Ford** and police associations across the province expressed condolences for Bali's death.

top_stories.title: Himachal receives nearly 2,790 tonnes of urea ahead of kharif | India News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Saurabh Parashar**, an Assistant Editor at **The Indian Express**, focuses on the socio-political landscape of **Himachal Pradesh**. His reporting covers topics such as drug trafficking, environmental issues, and governance challenges in the state. Recent articles include investigations into the impact of Chitta on border areas and the implications of the Shimla ropeway project for forest conservation.  **Parashar**'s expertise in law and his familiarity with remote regions make him a valuable resource for covering complex issues in **Himachal Pradesh**.

top_stories.title: $700,000 vs $3.8 Million: Ukraine Builds Its Own Cheap Answer To Patriot
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Fire Point**, a Ukrainian arms manufacturer, successfully tested its new surface-to-air missile, the FP-7.x, as an alternative to the **US**-made Patriot system. The FP-7.x is designed to intercept ballistic missiles and drones at an altitude of around 25 kilometers and costs about $700,000 compared to the $3.8 million price tag for a single Patriot missile.  Fire Point aims to produce three missiles daily starting in August with full readiness by 2027. The company is working with European partners on radar, tracking, and command-and-control technology. While experts acknowledge the FP-7.x could be a useful addition to Ukraine's existing air defense arsenal, it may not completely replace the Patriot system.

top_stories.title: Air Canada pilot flew more than 900 flights over 17 years using fake licence; police call case 'movie script' - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Geoffrey Wall**, a former **Air Canada** pilot, has been charged with fraud after flying over 900 flights without the required Airline Transport Pilot License (ATPL-A) for nearly 17 years.  The case is reminiscent of the film "Catch Me If You Can" and involved misrepresenting his qualifications to both his employer and regulators. **Air Canada** discovered anomalies in Wall's credentials during a routine review, leading to a criminal and regulatory investigation known as Project Icarus. The airline stated that passenger safety was not compromised due to mandatory training and competency checks for all pilots.  Wall faces seven criminal charges, including fraud over C$5,000, two counts of uttering forged documents, and three counts of possession of a counterfeit mark.
